```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
ends <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom",
         date %in% range(date))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(ends, aes(region, rate, fill = quarter)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")
```
